title: Connecting to God's Economy System
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner explains why giving tithes and offerings is a non-negotiable part of a vibrant faith, and how it's not just about money, but about positioning God as the number one priority in your life. With humor and heart, Pastor Zehner challenges listeners to rethink their finances and priorities, and invites them to connect with God's economy system, where God always comes through. Don't miss this inspiring message that will challenge and encourage you to put God first in every area of your life.
